updates.title: Introducing FDS Studio Intelligence Hub — Four-Week Managed Pilots for Game Studios
updates.summary: Forger Digital Solutions launches its first commercial offering: a managed four-week engineering intelligence pilot powered by Project Forge connecting Roblox Studio (Luau) and Unreal Engine (C++) codebases with technical documentation, design specs, and engine references. Founding Studio cohort open for the first five studio partners.

updates.title: Operation Digital Forge II: Commercial AI Solutions, Studio Workforces & BattleVerse Sub-Platforms
updates.summary: Forger Digital Solutions expands its public identity with dedicated commercial solutions hubs for gaming studios, anime and animation teams, software teams, and private enterprise AI—alongside BattleVerse Arena, BattleVerse Creator Studio, Apache-2.0 upstream model disclosures, and expanded Kayla Copilot portfolio guidance.

updates.title: Operation Digital Forge: Establishing FDS's AI Research & Ecosystem Architecture
updates.summary: Forger Digital Solutions reorganizes its public architecture around seven interconnected technologies—Alexandrite, Hackmanite, Cinnabar, Jaspilite, Forge BattleVerse, Project Forge, and State Lines—backed by permanent design governance and strict publication truthfulness.

updates.title: ForgerEMS v1.2.4-preview.1 Public Preview Available for Windows
updates.summary: Local-first Windows technician workbench published on GitHub Releases as unsigned portable ZIP and installer packages with SHA-256 checksums.

updates.title: CodeForge v0.2.0: Free-First Engineering & ForgeZero Boundaries
updates.summary: How CodeForge enforces fail-closed zero-cost routing and controlled tool execution across repositories. Installer downloads are currently paused while the release updates.

updates.title: Evidence Over Assumptions: Separating Execution from Proof
updates.summary: Why FDS treats 'it ran' and 'it worked' as fundamentally different claims—a principle now encoded across Project Forge, BattleVerse, and the FDS Evaluation Center.

updates.title: Introducing FDS Engineering Field Notes
updates.summary: Public build logs, methodology write-ups, and state-labeled technical notes documenting real changes across the studio.
